title: Shared PR configuration selectors and draft navigation
description: Set FARMSLOT_UI_URL, SETUP_FARM and SETUP_GITHUB_LOGIN. Optionally set SETUP_RULE_TEAM to verify separate discovery and monitor intervals through draft reload. Uses real gateway metadata in an isolated browser tab; no team/rule saves or work dispatches. Verifies shared controls, private draft reload and browser history.

configuration.intent: Automation settings retain their scope across navigation and reload.
